newsitem.title: USA: Frontier Insurance buys stake in American Country.
newsitem.headline: Frontier Insurance buys stake in American Country.

text.p: Frontier Insurance Group Inc said Wednesday it had acquired a 25 percent stake in American Country Holdings Inc, formerly known as Western Systems Corp.
American Country Insurance Co, headquartered in Chicago, has been writing insurance coverage for taxis and limousines for over 20 years and is rated A- by AM Best, Frontier said.
Frontier is an insurance holding company. Through its insurance subsidiaries, it is a national underwriter and creator of specialty insurance products.
Western Systems's trading symbols, WTSM and WTSMW, are being changed to ACHI and ACHIW, Frontier said.
